regions.cleaned_text: Many thanks for your double favor of Aug. 1st. I hope this finds you with less pain and brighter hopes. I've been thinking for sometime of telling you that you should spare yourself unnecessary details when convenient - as Jethro the Rev. Father-in-law of Moses told the great leader. Divide the work and share it with others. Just for Example, why write out such a detailed list every time you write? Not that they are not in- teresting or that I do not read them but because it must be more or less a drain on your time and energy, whereas they are really not necessary. Of course if you have something special its a dif- ferent story. Otherwise we pray all those inten- tions in just praying for you and your intentions in general ..... God bless you again ....
